name: Big Daddy's / Captain of the Guards Prime Rib of Beef
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Tiana's Place / Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table
searchKeywords: captain of the guards prime rib
whyItWorks: Slow-roasted prime rib is melt-in-your-mouth tender when you trim away the outer fat cap and peppercorn crust, pairing cleanly with the soft inside of a baked potato.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium, trim off the outer herb/peppercorn crust and heavy fat ribbon, scoop out the soft inside of the double-baked potato (discard the skin), and eat the well-cooked sweet carrots while skipping the fibrous broccolini stalks.
watchOuts: Outer black peppercorn crust and thick fat cap
